title: When Heaven Is Home
speaker: Pastor Wayne Holcomb
description:
When Heaven Is Home | Eternal Hope, Freedom from Fear, Heaven, and Salvation - John v14:1-3

Heaven is not a wishful idea but a promised reality for all who belong to Jesus Christ. In John v14:1-3, He comforts troubled hearts with the assurance that He is preparing a place for us and that He will come again to receive us to Himself. Our true citizenship is not rooted in this fading world, but in the everlasting home God has made ready for His people.

Revelation v21:1-5 lifts our eyes to the day when God dwells with us, wipes away every tear, and removes death, sorrow, crying, and pain forever. Because Jesus has conquered sin and death, we do not have to live in bondage to fear. Life is brief, eternity is real, and the call is urgent: turn from sin, trust Christ fully, and live with joyful expectation for the home that will never pass away.
